note: Demo: 33 real headlines found by web search on 2 Nov 2026, analysed by Claude in the radar's format, with the real outlets for each. Four months of history and market data fill in after the backfill job and first live run.

items.title: Vale Q3 2026 Iron Ore Output Falls 6% to 88.4 Mt, Net Profit Down 53%
items.what_happened: Vale's Q3 2026 iron ore output fell 6% year on year to 88.4 Mt and net profit dropped 53%; full-year output is guided to the low end of its range.
items.so_what: Less supply from the largest seaborne producer can firm premiums for high-grade ore and pellet feed. Vale's pellet volumes decide how much of this reaches our pricing.
items.action: Pull Vale's 3Q26 report for pellet volumes; update the Q1 pricing view.

items.title: Jindal Steel Duqm procures second plant for Oman complex
items.what_happened: Jindal Steel Duqm has procured a second plant for its steel complex in Duqm, Oman.
items.so_what: A GCC neighbour is adding capacity close to our markets. Depending on the plant type, it either competes for our customers or becomes a pellet buyer.
items.action: Confirm what the second plant is and its start date; brief the CEO this week.

items.title: [SMM Analysis] Environmental Protection-Driven Production Restrictions Weigh on Prices, Iron Ore Prices Expected to Consolidate at Lows Next Week
items.what_happened: SMM expects iron ore prices to stay near their lows next week as environmental production limits in China reduce steel mill demand.
items.so_what: Low ore prices ease our feed cost but also pull pellet prices down. Chinese mill curbs cut demand for imported ore and pellets.
items.action: Time the next concentrate purchase for the low; watch the pellet premium.

items.title: U.S. Steel breaks ground on $1.9 billion DRI plant in Osceola, Arkansas
items.what_happened: U.S. Steel broke ground on a $1.9 billion direct reduced iron plant in Osceola, Arkansas.
items.so_what: Another large DRI plant adds global demand for DR-grade pellets. It will likely use US pellets, but it tightens the DR-grade market overall and supports premiums.
items.action: Add to the DR-grade demand model; track how it sources pellets.

items.title: Proposal to launch DR-grade iron ore pellet premium weekly indicator
items.what_happened: Fastmarkets proposed a new weekly price indicator for the DR-grade iron ore pellet premium.
items.so_what: A public DR pellet premium makes pricing more transparent and could become the reference in our customer contracts.
items.action: Respond to the consultation; review price clauses in pellet contracts.

items.title: Metinvest to raise annual DR pellet output at Northern Iron Ore to four million mt
items.what_happened: Metinvest plans to raise DR pellet output at its Northern Iron Ore plant to 4 Mt a year.
items.so_what: More DR-grade supply chasing the same DRI customers, mainly in Europe and MENA.
items.action: Map Metinvest's likely target customers against ours.

items.title: thyssenkrupp Steel secures revised funding terms for Duisburg tkH2Steel decarbonization project
items.what_happened: thyssenkrupp Steel secured revised funding terms for its tkH2Steel decarbonisation project in Duisburg.
items.so_what: Keeps a large European DRI project alive: future demand for DR-grade pellets and a process reference for hydrogen-ready DRI.
items.action: Follow its pellet supply tenders; add to the European buyer list.

items.title: Early signs that the EU carbon border adjustment mechanism is reshaping EU–India steel trade
items.what_happened: A Nature Climate Change study finds early signs that CBAM is changing steel trade between the EU and India.
items.so_what: CBAM is already moving trade flows. Lower-carbon DRI-based steel gains an edge in EU sales; high-emission routes lose it.
items.action: Estimate our CBAM cost per tonne for EU-bound steel.

items.title: JFE Steel manufactures first DRI prototype powered by green hydrogen
items.what_happened: JFE Steel produced its first direct reduced iron using green hydrogen, at prototype scale, in Japan.
items.so_what: Hydrogen DRI is moving from paper to pilots in Asia. Pellet quality specs for hydrogen DRI may tighten, which matters for our process roadmap.
items.action: Ask the process team for a short brief on hydrogen DRI pellet specs.

items.title: MagIron's tests confirm premium DR-grade pellet quality
items.what_happened: MagIron reported tests confirming its pellets meet premium DR-grade quality.
items.so_what: A new DR-grade supplier in North America, more likely to serve US DRI plants than our markets.

items.title: Momentum shifts east in green steel transition
items.what_happened: IEEFA analysis says momentum in the green steel transition is shifting from Europe to Asia.
items.so_what: Future growth in DR pellet demand may sit more in Asia and the Middle East than in Europe, which shapes where we target sales.
items.action: Include in the 2027 market strategy review.

items.title: Steel: Confimi's Italian foundries take on Brussels: tariffs and the CBAM are hurting the supply chain
items.what_happened: Italian foundries in the Confimi group say EU steel tariffs and CBAM are hurting their supply chain.
items.so_what: European buyers are pushing back on CBAM costs, so the rules may still change. Keep EU pricing assumptions flexible.

items.title: UK steel industry expects higher prices in 2027, concerns that fabricated goods imports undermine safeguards and CBAM
items.what_happened: UK steelmakers expect higher steel prices in 2027 and worry that imports of fabricated goods undermine safeguards and CBAM.
items.so_what: Firmer UK prices could open some export room for semi-finished steel, but safeguards cap volumes.

items.title: LKAB to shut Kiruna pellet plant for months, cutting 2026 shipments
items.what_happened: LKAB is shutting one of its Kiruna pellet plants for several months, which cuts its 2026 pellet shipments.
items.so_what: Less pellet supply from a major European seller. Its DR and BF pellet customers will look for other suppliers, which supports premiums.
items.action: Contact LKAB's European customers this month with spot and term offers.

items.title: Simandou ore shipments could exceed 20 million tonnes in 2026
items.what_happened: Shipments from the Simandou iron ore project in Guinea could exceed 20 Mt in 2026.
items.so_what: A large new high-grade supply source pressures iron ore prices: cheaper feed for us, but it can also weigh on pellet prices.
items.action: Add Simandou volumes to the 2027 ore price and feed cost scenarios.

items.title: Rio Tinto's iron ore sales rise in Q3 2026 as Simandou ramp-up advances
items.what_happened: Rio Tinto's iron ore sales rose in Q3 2026 as its Simandou project ramped up.
items.so_what: More seaborne ore from the largest miner keeps iron ore prices under pressure through Q4.
items.action: Check if term ore contracts can be repriced lower.

items.title: Fortescue Q1 FY27 iron ore shipments fall 5.8% YoY to 46.8 Mt
items.what_happened: Fortescue's iron ore shipments fell 5.8% year on year to 46.8 Mt in its first quarter of FY27.
items.so_what: Partly offsets new supply from Simandou and Rio Tinto; little direct effect on pellet markets.

items.title: World crude steel output down 0.2 percent in September 2026
items.what_happened: World crude steel output fell 0.2% year on year to 142.4 Mt in September 2026, per worldsteel.
items.so_what: Flat global steel output means flat demand for pellets and DRI feed; growth must come from taking share.

items.title: China's September crude steel output rises 0.1% year on year, ending months-long slump
items.what_happened: China's crude steel output rose 0.1% year on year in September, its first rise after months of decline.
items.so_what: A tentative floor in Chinese output could stabilise iron ore demand, though one month is not a trend.
items.action: Watch October output before changing the price outlook.

items.title: China mill profitability falls to 7%
items.what_happened: Only about 7% of Chinese steel mills are profitable, according to a mid-October survey.
items.so_what: Loss-making Chinese mills cut output and push cheap steel exports, which pressures steel prices in our markets.
items.action: Stress-test steel margins for lower Asian export prices.

items.title: Freight rates for iron ore fell in October compared to September
items.what_happened: Freight rates for iron ore fell in October compared with September.
items.so_what: Cheaper sea freight lowers the landed cost of imported ore and concentrate.
items.action: Fix freight for Q1 cargoes while rates are lower.

items.title: India extends import duties on flat steel to 3 years
items.what_happened: India extended its import duties on flat steel to three years.
items.so_what: Steel exports into India stay costly, while protected Indian mills keep expanding and buying pellets and DRI feed.
items.action: Shift Indian focus from steel sales to pellet supply.

items.title: Hadeed holds October long steel prices as demand remains slow
items.what_happened: Hadeed kept its October long steel prices unchanged because demand is slow.
items.so_what: The GCC's price leader is not raising prices, so regional rebar and long product prices stay flat into Q4.
items.action: Hold GCC long product prices; avoid building stock.

items.title: EMSTEEL advances sustainable steelmaking with electric process gas heater pilot
items.what_happened: EMSTEEL is piloting an electric process gas heater to cut emissions in its steelmaking.
items.so_what: A GCC peer is electrifying part of its DRI process; a lower-carbon route matters for CBAM exposure and could be copied.
items.action: Ask the process team to review the electric heater pilot.

items.title: ArcelorMittal Q3 2026 earnings due 5 November
items.what_happened: ArcelorMittal reports third-quarter 2026 results on 5 November.
items.so_what: The world's largest steelmaker outside China will show where margins and demand are heading in Europe and the Americas.
items.action: Benchmark its EBITDA per tonne against ours after release.

items.title: SMM: September global crude steel outlook, European supply squeeze overshadows headline swings
items.what_happened: SMM analysis points to a supply squeeze in European steel behind the September global figures.
items.so_what: Tighter European steel supply could open space for imports of semi-finished steel and DRI products.

items.title: October Sees Near Daily Strikes on Ships in Hormuz
items.what_happened: USNI News reports near-daily strikes on ships in the Strait of Hormuz through October.
items.so_what: Every ore, pellet and steel cargo into or out of the Gulf carries higher war-risk insurance, freight costs and delay risk.
items.action: Review Hormuz-exposed cargoes, insurance cover and raw material buffer stocks.

items.title: Strait of Hormuz: After more oil left the Gulf, Iran tries to regain its stranglehold on shipping
items.what_happened: CNN analysis: after more oil left the Gulf, Iran is trying to regain control over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
items.so_what: Renewed pressure on the strait keeps energy prices and Gulf freight volatile, raising gas and logistics cost risk.
items.action: Stress-test energy and freight costs for a renewed Hormuz disruption.

items.title: GCC steel supply crunch deepens despite ceasefire talks
items.what_happened: Fastmarkets reports the GCC steel supply crunch is deepening despite ceasefire talks.
items.so_what: Tight regional supply can lift local steel prices for producers inside the Gulf, while imported inputs stay at risk.
items.action: Prioritise domestic GCC customers; secure raw material shipments and buffer stocks.

items.title: Mesabi Metallics launches Patriot Pellet, a premium DR-grade iron ore
items.what_happened: Mesabi Metallics launched Patriot Pellet, a premium DR-grade pellet from a new US mine and pellet plant.
items.so_what: New DR-grade pellet supply in the US, aimed at American DRI plants; adds competition in the premium segment.

items.title: Jindal Steel Oman DRI plant sets new global production benchmark
items.what_happened: Jindal Steel Oman says its DRI plant set a new global production benchmark.
items.so_what: A GCC neighbour is running its DRI plant at record output, raising the operating benchmark and its competitiveness.
items.action: Benchmark our DRI plant utilisation against Jindal Steel Oman.

items.title: GravitHy has chosen Danieli to build a DRI plant in Fos-sur-Mer
items.what_happened: GravitHy selected Danieli to build a direct reduced iron plant at Fos-sur-Mer in France.
items.so_what: Another European DRI project moving forward adds future demand for DR-grade pellets.

items.title: Ecolant to launch Russia's first large-scale DRI-EAF steel plant in Q4 2026
items.what_happened: Ecolant plans to start Russia's first large-scale DRI-EAF steel plant in the fourth quarter of 2026.
items.so_what: More DRI-EAF capacity in Russia, likely fed by Russian pellets; little direct effect on our markets.
